issuer: the General Traffic Department (الإدارة العامة للمرور) of the Ministry of Interior
note: Read 2026-10-30. Age: article 88 of the traffic law's executive regulation (Ministerial Resolution 81/1976), in the General Traffic Department's own compilation 'التنظيم القانوني للمرور' (the PDF its page links, edition of September 2022, page 128, read by eye in the page image as its text layer drops the article's items): a private licence needs the applicant to be at least 18. The licence follows a learner's permit and the theory and practical tests (the Ministry's procedure page), so 18 is the licence's own age. Term: Ministerial Resolution 425/2025, published in Kuwait Al-Youm and quoted in full by Al-Jarida on 23 March 2025, rewrote article 85: a private licence runs 15 years for Kuwaitis and GCC citizens, 5 years for non-Kuwaitis, and as long as the review card for illegal residents. 15 is held, a citizen's; the form holds one term, so a non-Kuwaiti's 5 years aren't held (the Ministry's procedure page still says a non-Kuwaiti's licence runs as long as their residence, written before the resolution). Fee: the Ministry's procedure page for issuing a Kuwaiti or non-Kuwaiti licence gives 'الرسوم 10 د.ك', the same for both. Non-Kuwaitis also need two years' legal residence, a monthly salary of at least KD 600 and a university degree unless exempted (Resolution 270/2020; not held). The law was amended by Decree-Law 5/2025, whose text wasn't read; the age article wasn't among the changes quoted in the press read. No identity card is issued by the department; the direct exchange of GCC licences (a procedure named on the Ministry's page) isn't held as a list.

sources.title: Al-Jarida, 15 عاماً رخصة القيادة للمواطنين والخليجيين.. و5 سنوات للوافدين (23 March 2025)
sources.said: صدر في الجريدة الرسمية الكويت اليوم قرار وزير الداخلية رقم 425 لسنة 2025 ... 1- رخصة سوق خاصة: ... وتسري للكويتيين ومواطني دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي لمدة (15) سنة. ... ولغير الكويتيين تكون لمدة (5) سنوات.
